title: A Judge reads the prompt
text: Each round one player is the Judge. A prompt with a blank goes up on the TV.

title: Play your funniest card
text: Everyone else picks the answer card from their hand that fills the blank best, or writes their own.

title: The Judge picks a star
text: Answers are shown without names. The Judge picks a favourite and that player wins the star.

title: Take turns judging
text: The Judge rotates every round. Collect the most stars to win.
